text: In this month our most-repeated phrase was "health protection act," which 30 of us reached on September 24. Close behind, 29 of us said "national defense authorization act ndaa" on September 23, and on that same day 24 of us said "the national defense authorization" and 23 of us "the national defense authorization act." The defense bill and the health measure were the two poles we converged on. On September 24, 21 of us said "the supreme court" and 18 of us "health care providers." Earlier, on September 15, 19 of us said "build back better." We did not originate most of this language in this month: "health protection act" traces first to Michael F. Bennet, "build back better" to Darren Soto, "health care providers" to Peter Welch. We report the convergence as we recorded it.
